name: Michigan Sunrise - Sativa [20 pack] (200mg THC)
description:
Sativa 

Per Package: 200mg 

Per Piece: 20mg 

Inspired by the flavors of a Tequila Sunrise, these fast-acting gummies blend a delicious citrus-cherry taste with 30+ Sativa-leaning terpenes. They have a typical 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration. And like all Wana edibles, they're vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
